strategies.name: Detect malicious IDE extension install/usage and IDE tunneling

analytics.name: Analytic 1548
analytics.guidance: Adversary installs or side-loads an IDE extension (VS Code, IntelliJ/JetBrains, Eclipse) or enables IDE tunneling. Chain: (1) IDE binary starts on a non-developer endpoint or server, often with install/force/tunnel flags → (2) extension files/registrations appear under user profile → (3) browser/IDE initiates outbound connections to extension marketplaces, update endpoints, or IDE remote/tunnel services → (4) optional child tools (ssh, node, powershell) execute under the IDE context.

tuning.description: Executable names/paths (e.g., code.exe, idea64.exe, eclipse.exe, jetbrains-gateway.exe) vary by version and packaging.
Flags such as --install-extension, --force, --disable-extensions, --user-data-dir, --uninstall-extension, tunnel/remote flags are tunable.
List of hosts where IDEs should never run (prod servers, DCs).
Approved extension marketplaces/ide services; use to suppress benign traffic.
Correlation horizon (e.g., 15–30m) between process start, file writes, and outbound IDE/tunnel connections.

analytics.name: Analytic 1549
analytics.guidance: Adversary installs or abuses IDE extensions via CLI or direct write to profile directories and then communicates with marketplaces or remote tunnel services. Chain: auditd execve (code/idea/eclipse) with install/update flags or writes under ~/.vscode/extensions, ~/.config/JetBrains → outbound flows to *.visualstudio.com, marketplace.visualstudio.com, *.jetbrains.com, githubusercontent.com, or SSH/WebSocket tunnel endpoints → optional ssh/node processes spawned by IDE.

tuning.description: Per-distro/profile extension directories differ; tune for Chromium/JetBrains snap/flatpak paths.
Enterprise-approved repos and proxies to reduce FPs.
Limit to non-developer users or production servers.
Join horizon across file, process, and network telemetry.

log_sources.name: NSM:Flow
log_sources.channel: Connections from IDE hosts to marketplace/tunnel domains

analytics.name: Analytic 1550
analytics.guidance: Adversary adds IDE extensions or plugins (VS Code, JetBrains Toolbox/EAP, Eclipse) via GUI or CLI, possibly via managed profiles. Chain: process start with install/update flags → plist/extension folder changes under ~/Library/Application Support/Code or ~/Library/Application Support/JetBrains → outbound connections to marketplaces/tunnel services → optional helper (ssh/node) spawned.

tuning.description: Per-app preference domains and plugin directories vary by version.
If MDM installs extensions, allowlist those events to avoid FPs.
Correlation range between install and first beacon.
